card.name: The word multimodal in pain management
card.fires_on: The ending piece "odal" of the word "multimodal" in the phrase "ensure that a multimodal approach to pain management", in opioid label text about chronic pain.

modes.label: multimodal approach
modes.description: The final piece of "multimodal" before "approach to pain management" in opioid warnings.
modes.example: ensure that a multim<<odal>> approach to pain management, including mental health

card.plain: It lights up on the last part of the word multimodal in the opioid label advice to use a multimodal approach to pain care.
